gotchas.procedure_section: Schedules K-1 - S corp IRC 311(b) property distribution
gotchas.title: S corp omitted the 311(b) gain on the truck
gotchas.trap: Enter the K-1 as issued: box 1 $62,000, property distribution at book value $12,000 -> no gain.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Distribution of appreciated property = deemed sale at FMV at the corporate level (IRC 311(b), 1371(a)). Gain $20,000 (FMV $32,000 - adjusted basis $12,000) is all IRC 1245 recapture (accumulated depreciation $33,000) -> ordinary, flows through box 1. Manually add to the K-1 ordinary income: $82,000.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedules K-1 - basis limitation (Section 5 line 16 other increases)
gotchas.title: Basis ordering with a property distribution
gotchas.trap: Reduce basis by the book value (or reduce by FMV without first adding the gain) -> wrong ending basis, or a phantom excess-distribution capital gain.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Form 7203: increase stock basis by the gain first, then reduce by distributions at FMV ($72,000); basis before distributions $178,150 is sufficient -> no capital gain; ending basis $101,750. Elena's basis in the truck = FMV $32,000 (IRC 301(d)).

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedules K-1 - S corp accountant fails to reflect 311(b); Review - tax research
gotchas.title: Reporting inconsistently with the K-1 requires Form 8082
gotchas.trap: Silently report different numbers from the K-1 (IRS matching / IRC 6037(c) consistency) or wait for an amended K-1 past the extended due date.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Attach Form 8082 (inconsistent treatment) identifying box 1 and box 16D differences; notify the S corp's CPA to amend the 1120-S (agreed 09/02/2026). Keep the email in the WP.

gotchas.procedure_section: QBI - ensure QBI, UBIA and W-2 wages properly reported
gotchas.title: QBI includes the 1245 recapture; reduced by SE health
gotchas.trap: Use K-1 Statement A QBI of $62,000 (omits gain), or exclude the gain as 'not QBI', or ignore the health-insurance reduction.
gotchas.correct_treatment: IRC 1245 recapture is ordinary trade-or-business income -> QBI. QBI = $82,000 - $7,800 2% shareholder health deduction = $74,200; taxable income below $197,300 -> 20% = $14,840; W-2 wages/UBIA not limiting.

gotchas.title: 2% shareholder health insurance
gotchas.trap: Treat the $7,800 in box 1 as ordinary wages with no deduction (or deduct it on Schedule A medical).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Premiums paid by the S corp for a >2% shareholder are included in W-2 box 1 (not boxes 3/5) and deductible on Sch 1 line 17 (Notice 2008-1), limited to the S corp wages.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedules K-1 - trust termination suspended passive losses
gotchas.title: Trust's $18,400 suspended PAL on the distributed condo
gotchas.trap: Deduct the $18,400 suspended loss on Schedule E (Hector: 'you might be able to use them').
gotchas.correct_treatment: IRC 469(j)(12): on distribution of the passive activity the losses are never deductible; they increase the basis of the distributed property. Condo basis $222,546 + $18,400 = $240,946 (carryover basis under IRC 643(e), no 643(e)(3) election). Record in PERM for 2026 depreciation.

gotchas.title: Trust's long-term capital loss carryover passes to beneficiary
gotchas.trap: Ignore box 11 code E (not on 1099s) or treat it as a current-year K-1 loss.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Final K-1 box 11 code E $3,200 -> Schedule D line 14 in the beneficiary's year the trust terminates (Reg. 1.642(h)-1). Net capital loss limited to $3,000; $200 carries to 2026.

gotchas.procedure_section: Scan - duplicate documents (draft vs final K-1)
gotchas.title: Draft trust K-1 in the PBC
gotchas.trap: Load both the June DRAFT and August FINAL trust K-1s (double interest/dividends), or use the draft's $410 interest.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Use only the FINAL K-1 (interest $420). Bookmark the draft as superseded.

gotchas.title: No 2025 Schedule E for the inherited-then-distributed condo
gotchas.trap: Start depreciation in 2025 on stepped-up or FMV basis ($305,000), or claim the trust's 2025 depreciation again.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Not held out for rent in 2025 (painting; listed March 2026) -> no 2025 Sch E. 2026: continue trust's 27.5-yr schedule on carryover building basis $174,546 (IRC 168(i)(7)); the $14,431 basis increase is treated as a new 27.5-yr asset (assumption). Holding period tacks.
